problems: rule lists vowel letters (a, e, i, o, u) while saying 'sound'; learner following letters writes 'an uniform', 'a hour'

fix.rule: Use an before a word that starts with a vowel sound (an egg, an hour), and a before others.

problems: false 'always': not every sentence needs am/is/are (I like cats); invites the common error 'I am like cats'

fix.rule: When there is no action word, use am, is or are: I am, he/she/it is, you/we/they are.

problems: his '(a man)' / her '(a woman)' does not cover boys and girls, yet examples use Omar, Laila and the girls

fix.rule: Choose by the owner: my, your, his (boy or man), her (girl or woman), our, their (more than one).

problems: interleaving item has two correct answers (The cat is on the box is also correct)

fix.interleaving_item: Write in or on: The cup is ___ the table. -> answer: on

problems: rule's '-s after a number' strays from the outcome and is false for one and for irregular plurals (three sheep)
right/wrong do not show the outcome's main error (there is with a plural)

fix.rule: Say there is for one thing and there are for two or more: there are two cats.
fix.wrong: There is four ducks on the lake.
fix.usual_error: there is with two or more things, or no is/are after there

problems: usual error names 'one long line joined with and' but the wrong sentence does not show it

fix.usual_error: no capital at the start, small i for I, or no full stop

problems: 'add -ed to the verb' overgeneralises to all verbs (goed)
'even when a word like yesterday is there' is confusing wording

fix.rule: For a finished past action, add -ed to most verbs (walk - walked), also after words like yesterday.

problems: interleaving item has two correct answers (Sometimes the parrot sings is also correct)
item does not test the partner form (third person -s)

fix.interleaving_item: Write the correct form: The parrot always ___ (sing) in the morning. -> answer: sings

problems: interleaving answer 'an' is not one of the offered choices (a or some)

fix.interleaving_item: Write a, an or some: The horse wants ___ apple. -> answer: an

problems: word set has duplicate 'bananas' and the verbs eat, drink, which are not foods or drinks

fix.rule: We eat food, and we eat soup too; we drink water, juice and milk.
fix.word_set: bread, rice, apple, milk, egg, fish, soup, water, juice, tea, cheese, chicken, banana

problems: rule's 'v (not f)' has no word in the set; 'short names' untrue for scissors, notebook
'rubber' has an adult meaning in US English; not safe for all ages

fix.rule: Write p and b carefully in classroom words: pen, pencil, bag, board.
fix.worked_examples: [eraser] The robot has an eraser. | [scissors] The robot cuts paper with scissors.
fix.word_set: desk, chair, pen, pencil, book, board, bag, ruler, eraser, marker, notebook, scissors
fix.usual_error: b for p (ben, bencil), or an Arabic phrase word for word

problems: wrong 'sefen' shows f for v, not the named error v for f (fivteen)
wrong 'little big' is not a real learner error and does not show the named error (wrong partner, long for tall)

fix.usual_error: the wrong word of a pair (long for tall with people and animals, new for young)

problems: word set includes personality words kind, funny, friendly, not hair/eyes/height

fix.word_set: hair, eyes, nose, big, red, tall, short, long, curly, straight, thin, black, brown, blue, green, grey
